description:
The Firmstrong Urban Lady 7-Speed is a great choice for women who want a little something extra from their cruiser bicycle. While it keeps the classic, trendy design that beach cruisers are known for, the seven speeds and handbrakes make this bike far more versatile than a standard model. It is particularly well-suited for tackling hills or embarking on long-distance rides that might be too challenging for a single-speed bike.

At the core of the Urban Lady 7-Speed is the Shimano gear system, which is widely considered the best seven-speed option for a cruiser. This system uses a derailleur to move the chain between different sprockets as you shift gears. Gear one is the easiest to pedal, making it ideal for going uphill or maintaining a slow, steady pace. Gear seven provides the most resistance, which is what you will use for high-speed riding and coasting downhill. These gears give the bike the functionality of a hybrid or mountain bike, yet you still get to enjoy the comfortable, upright riding position that makes cruisers so popular.

If you are looking to commute, get some exercise, or ride over 15 miles in a single trip, the seven speeds are a fantastic feature to have. They allow you to switch the resistance back and forth during your ride, giving your legs a break when needed. To handle the extra speed, this bike features front and rear Tektro V-brakes, providing much more stopping power than a traditional coaster brake. The gear system also includes a rear freewheel, so you can pedal backwards freely while riding without engaging the brakes. The Urban Lady 7-Speed is a durable, practical upgrade for anyone who wants a classic cruiser look with the performance to go the distance.

15” Steel Frame with 26” Aluminum Wheels

7 Speed Shimano Bicycle has a wide range of gears for all types of riding; short rides, long distance and uphill riding

Front and Rear Tektro V Brakes are easy to operate and provide great stopping power even on downhill rides

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provides a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Thick Rubber Grips

Bicycle Weighs 34.5 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Women 5’2" – 5’11" Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 15mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 40 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Color Matched Fenders can be Purchased Separately for $49.99.

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
